meta.purpose: SC-004 baseline: loss of later-referenced file paths / error messages under the EXISTING summarization-based compaction — extended: same measurement with two summarizer models

qwen3.8-27b.note: prime-agent compaction uses the session model; the configured local-tailscale provider endpoint serves the measurement

kimi-k3.note: prime-agent kimi-coding provider; same prompts/settings as the qwen arm, no cache — every run is a live API call

meta.prompts: verbatim replica of SUMMARIZATION_SYSTEM_PROMPT / SUMMARIZATION_PROMPT / KERNEL_PERSIST_SUMMARY_NOTE + serializeConversation from prime-agent dist
meta.cache: none — every run calls the summarizer live
meta.deviation: T001 asked for 80-150 tool-call transcripts; only 1 of 48 real sessions qualifies, so the 6 largest real sessions were used (34-98 tool calls).
